test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following has written ‘Sangeet Kala Prakash’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ramakrishnabuva Vaze__.**

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramakrishnabuva Vaze** earned appreciation within and outside India.
 
• **The ruler of Nepal **honored him and **appointed him as a court musician**.
 
• He **cut a number of commercial discs**, which became** immensely popular.**
 
• He wrote the musical work** 'Sangeet Kala Prakash'.**

• Prabhu Atre (born 13 September 1932) is an **Indian classical vocalist from the Kirana Gharana.**
 
• **Pandit Jasraj **was an** Indian ****classical vocalist**, belonging to the **Mewati Gharana***. His musical career **spanned 75 years resulting in national and international fame, respect, and numerous major awards and accolades.**
 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva **originally known as **Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath** was an** ****Indian classical singer,** well known for his** unique vocal style **and for his **refusal to be bound by the tradition of any *gharana*****. **
